phaseFarming.methodologyNote: Computed from actual timestamped timeline checkpoints using separate minionsKilled (lane) and jungleMinionsKilled (jungle) counters. Games ending before a checkpoint are excluded and never extrapolated; individual missed CS is never claimed.

leadRetention.associationNote: Objective and tower events in the 10-20m window include all available team events (not only personally last-hit events) and represent temporal association only, not personal player credit or proof of a throw.

deathCost.goldComponentDefinition: baseKillBountyGold (Riot event.bounty) is the base kill reward to the killer; shutdownBountyGold (Riot event.shutdownBounty) is the additional streak shutdown bonus. combinedBountyGold = baseKillBountyGold + shutdownBountyGold (disjoint components, never double-counted). Unknown fields remain null, not 0; no lost farm or death avoidability is inferred.

unspentGold.samplingSemanticsNote: Derived from discrete 1-minute participantFrame.currentGold snapshots (not continuous duration). High balances before purchases are descriptive timestamp samples, not an automatic mistake score or invented recall window.

teamObjectives.attributionNote: Team objective outcomes (first flags and kills from MatchDto.info.teams) are reported separately from personal last-hits/takedowns. Absent fields remain null and are excluded from denominators rather than treated as 0.
